components.text: Economy standard: one cabin bag up to 7 kg with maximum size 55 × 35 × 25 cm (total 115 cm including handles and wheels).
One additional personal item up to 3 kg is allowed, such as a handbag or laptop bag, if it fits under the seat.
Standard domestic economy: 15 kg checked baggage per passenger.
Maximum size for one checked piece is 158 cm total linear dimensions (L+W+H).
A single checked bag must not exceed 32 kg for safety handling.
Note: These details are based on IndiGo guidelines.
IndiGo states excess checked baggage is charged per kilogram over the allowance at check-in.
Published domestic airport excess rates are commonly around ₹600 per kg or ₹1,000 for an additional piece depending on purchase method and route; pre-booked excess is cheaper than airport purchase.
Lite fares may have no free checked baggage; checked weight must be bought separately.
Higher domestic bundles such as UpFront can include more checked allowance, and premium products may allow a higher cabin weight limit.
Exact excess pricing can vary by route and booking channel, so the fare rules on the ticket or booking page should be checked before travel.
